# Anchors fixture

Cross-refs that exercise every character class supported by Obsidian-style
heading anchors. Each link below must resolve to one of the headings further
down. The bullet list mixes bare-fragment and angle-bracket forms so the
preprocess covers both CommonMark spellings.

- ASCII: [§ascii](#Ascii heading)
- Cyrillic-only: [§ru](<#Кириллица только>)
- Em-dash: [§dash](<#3.2 Camunda — соседняя ИС вне периметра ПФ>)
- Dot-bearing: [§dot](<#4. Plan B: если Путь 1 не получится>)
- Slash-bearing: [§slash](<#4.2 Сводка путей 2/3/4>)
